text:
maria: quick check — I'm trying to push Slate13B into the catalog. weights are at s3://rw-models/slate13b/v1/ (sha: b7c2f1a). tokenizer.json looks weird: punctuation sometimes gets a leading space on decode. anyone seen this? cc @ajay for perf config

ajay: I pulled the weights and ran a tiny smoke on a single GPU: p3dn, batch=4, seq=512 -> median latency ~78ms/token. the tokenizer token->id mapping differs from our standard tests, so that could explain decode spacing. try running the tok sanity script: `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --model s3://rw-models/slate13b/v1/`

sam: I can take perf tomorrow. planning a batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16] plus a max_batch_tokens sweep. I'll capture throughput and p99 latency and put results in the perf-run sheet. any target SLOs?

tara: heads-up — infra's deploy-bot will reject a model manifest missing required fields. I noticed slate13b/v1/manifest.json is missing `kvg_size`. if that stays missing CI will fail and the catalog entry won't publish. I can patch but want confirmation from the owner.

maria: thanks — I accidentally left kvg_size out, adding it now. tokenizer quirk: this model's tokenizer was exported with byte-level normalization off; punctuation gets an extra space when decoding. quick fix locally was to set `add_prefix_space=true` in tokenizer.json — fixed decode on our sample prompts but we should validate more examples.

deploy-bot: Manifest updated for slate13b/v1 by tara at 1934568000. CI: lint OK. :white_check_mark:

ajay: another config note — for 2048 max_seq workloads we should tune `runner.batcher.max_batch_tokens`. default 4096 token cap means smaller batches and you won't hit desired GPU utilization. consider 8192 or 16384 depending on memory headroom. watch the tail latency though. Example runner snippet we use for similar models:

```
runner:
  batcher:
    max_batch_tokens: 8192
    max_batch_items: 16
    max_wait_ms: 8
```

sam: confirmed. I'll run sweep with batch_sizes [1,2,4,8,16], max_batch_tokens [4096,8192], and quant modes [fp16,int8]. expected outcome: throughput ramps until ~8 per GPU then diminishing returns. I'll post a short summary + CSV to the perf-run sheet (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SLATE13B-PERF).

maria: quick request — I opened PR #4123 with the manifest + tokenizer tweak. @eng-ml can someone review? it's a tiny change but want it merged before the scheduled perf run.

ajay: reviewed, left one nit about the tokenizer comment. @maria please re-run the smoke after merge and tag me.

sam: scheduling the perf run for 1934590000 (tomorrow 09:00 PT). will post run command and env in thread before starting.

maria: thanks all — pinging reviewers and will post confirmation once the manifest + tokenizer change is deployed. :pray:
__note: This document is a single Slack thread (root + replies). Messages are short and in Slack style as required.
